subject: SOC2 re-attestation + log retention change — renewal / seat uplift
messages:
From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@nexatlas.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nexatlas.com
Date: 2028-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal coming up — SOC2 re-attest, retention change and seat request

Hi Rishi,

Renewal for our account is up in late August and our security team asked for an updated SOC2 re-attestation plan before we sign. Two asks from their side: (1) a shorter evidence handoff timeline (they want a one-week window for a dry-run), and (2) a change to log retention for our audit logs — they want retention extended from 90 days to 18 months for the next 12 months as part of our contract.

Separately, product expects to increase query volume for our Q4 launch and we want to secure burst capacity (roughly 3x current throughput for a 48h window) and add 30 seats to our Dedicated pool. Can you confirm whether that's doable and how that impacts pricing/term?

Can we schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week? Also please send a short list of the SOC2 artifacts you can provide (audit firm attestation date, log export procedure, DR plan, encryption details).

Thanks — Emma

Emma Turner
Head of InfoSec, NexAtlas
emma.turner@nexatlas.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@nexatlas.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — SOC2 re-attest, retention change and seat request

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and the level setting. Short answers up front: yes, we can support an 18-month audit-log retention window and we can provision a temporary burst (3x, 48h) for a migration/launch event. Seat add + burst will change the PS/pricing; I'll outline options below.

High-level plan and asks from our side:
- Evidence & attestation: we can deliver an SOC2 Type II attestation PDF (most recent: 2028-04-19), our internal control matrix, log-export playbook, and an S3 staging path for evidence handoff. I'll attach the evidence request template for your team to map items to owners.
- Dry-run: we can schedule a dry-run week of Aug 6; we'll need a 5-business-day lead to stage logs and grant read-only access to the SX bucket.
- Retention: we can extend the audit-log retention to 18 months for your org. This will be implemented as a per-customer retention policy and incur incremental storage charges — I'll include an estimate below.
- Burst & seats: 30-seat addition (Dedicated) + 48h 3x burst: options are (A) reserve seats with a 12-month term (best per-seat rate) or (B) add on-demand seats + one-off burst credit. I'll put pricing for both in the follow-up.

Attachments: evidence-request-template.xlsx, DRP-overview.pdf, renewal-term-draft.docx

Next steps: please confirm (1) whether Aug 6 dry-run window works, (2) whether we should prepare a 12-month committed seat quote or an on-demand uplift quote, and (3) names of the NexAtlas reviewers who need read access for the evidence bucket.

Happy to walk through this on a call. Proposed times: Tue 2028-07-18 10:00 PDT or Wed 2028-07-19 14:00 PDT.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Renewal coming up — SOC2 re-attest, retention change and seat request

Kimberly / Ben / Monica — forwarding NexAtlas' asks (see below). Key questions: can infra support a temporary retention policy override for 18 months scoped to their tenant, and can SRE guarantee a 3x burst for 48h without dropping latency SLOs?

Quick bullets for ops pricing:
- Storage delta estimate: current log footprint ~2.4TB / month (per NexAtlas telemetry). 18-month retention vs 90 days adds ~ (18 - 3) * 2.4TB = ~36TB additional storage. Rough cost estimate = $2,700/month of incremental storage (internal ballpark); need finance confirmation.
- Burst feasibility: we can approach with either reserved burst nodes (higher baseline) or a scheduled pre-warm (preferred). Monica, can your team confirm pre-warm timeline to assure cold-starts won't impact token latency?
- Evidence handoff: legal wants explicit wording for short dry-run and S3 read-only creds; Ben, can you draft the addendum with an 8-business-day SLA for evidence availability during the dry-run window?

I'll slot the Aug 6 dry-run if we can get sign-off by Jul 20.

--

Date: 2028-07-23T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — SOC2 re-attest, retention change and seat request

Emma — thanks for the patience while we scoped this. Apologies for the long note, wanted to be specific so your security and procurement teams have everything in one thread.

Summary / final proposal
1) Evidence & attestation
- We will provide: SOC2 Type II PDF (attested 2028-04-19), control matrix export (CSV), log-export runbook, encryption & key management summary, and our DR (disaster recovery) overview.
- Dry-run: we can run a dry-run Aug 6–10 with a 5-business-day prep window; evidence S3 bucket will be staged and read-only credentials created for the reviewers.

2) Retention change
- We will apply a per-tenant retention policy for NexAtlas to retain audit logs for 18 months for a 12-month term starting on the renewal effective date. Incremental storage charge: $2,700/month (estimated). This will appear as an add-on line item.

3) Capacity & seats
- 30-seat commitment: 12-month term at the committed seat rate (see attached renewal-term-draft.docx).
- Burst: scheduled pre-warm + 48h 3x capacity window; one-time burst reservation fee = equivalent of 4 days of peak committed capacity (details in attachment). We recommend the pre-warm 72h before launch to avoid cold-cache latency.

4) Legal / contract changes
- We'll include a short addendum that codifies the dry-run window obligations (evidence availability), the retention policy change, and the burst scheduling terms. I'll attach a DocuSign-ready draft.

Attachments: docusign-renewal-draft.pdf (for signature), renewal-term-draft.docx, DRP-overview.pdf

Action items
- From NexAtlas: confirm Aug 6 dry-run and list of reviewers for S3 access (emails).
- From NexAtlas procurement: confirm whether you'd like the committed seat quote (faster review) or an on-demand uplift.
- From me: I'll circulate the DocuSign link once you confirm the terms so procurement can sign ahead of your scheduled dry-run.

Thanks — we can jump on a 30-min call if you want to walk through numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
